name: Maro Vell
title: The Unsworn
lore: No lord may claim a wanderer, and Maro has made a trade of it. Ask who pays, and the hood tilts away.

name: Ilyan Veyr
title: The Bluefire Adept
lore: He learned that cold flame burns longer. Three kings have asked him to light their lamps; none asked twice.

name: Ysolde Rime
title: Winter's Voice
lore: Winter came to the Crownlands once, wearing her face. It left only when she asked it to.

name: Kael Embergate
title: Warden of the Burning Gate
lore: He held the Embergate for nine nights with a torch and a stubborn temper. The gate still stands. So does he.

name: Nyra Thistledark
title: The Thorn Archer
lore: Every arrow carries a thorn-mark from a court that no longer admits to existing. She has never missed twice.

name: Orrin Halewick
title: Keeper of Candles
lore: He remembers every oath sworn in the Crownlands, and exactly who broke them. He is far too polite to say so.

name: Seraphine Dawnmere
title: Sworn of the Dawn Banner
lore: She took her vow at sixteen. She has not yet met a dawn worth leaving early.

name: Vorka Redtusk
title: Tusk-Marked Raider
lore: The Crownlands call her a raider. Her clan calls her home. Both are right, and neither is brave enough to say it to her face.

name: Thessaly Greenhollow
title: Voice of the Hollow
lore: The old woods speak plainly to her. Mostly they ask her to be careful, and to bring more salt.

name: Haldor Wolfbrow
title: Last of the Pale Clan
lore: He wears a wolf's pelt and the headband of a clan that is gone. He fights for both of them.
